text: Any emoji works. Press {shortcut} for the system emoji picker.
translated: 任何表情符号均可。按 {shortcut} 打开系统表情符号选择器。

text: Token budget for each promoted snippet. Provenance stays attached.
translated: 每个晋升片段的令牌预算。来源信息仍会附加。

text: Queued attachments are missing or unreadable. This may be a stale copy from another tab. Check the conversation, then discard this row and attach the files again if needed. No new message was sent.
translated: 排队的附件缺失或无法读取。这可能是来自另一个标签页的过期副本。请检查对话，然后丢弃此行，如有需要请重新附加文件。未发送新消息。
无法加载任务详细信息。

text: The current browser navigation rules block this address. Select another tab or enter an allowed address.
translated: 当前浏览器导航规则阻止了此地址。请选择其他标签页或输入允许的地址。
已移除 {removed} 条重复的 dream 条目。

text: Open the configured authenticated proxy or SSO dashboard URL and sign in there, rather than visiting the Gateway directly.
translated: 请打开已配置的经过身份验证的代理或 SSO 仪表板 URL 并在那里登录，而不是直接访问 Gateway。

text: When someone mentions you in a chat, it appears here.
translated: 当有人在聊天中提到你时，会显示在这里。

text: Stops unfinished personal publication. Published work stays intact; revoke the app grant separately in GitHub settings.
translated: 停止未完成的个人发布。已发布的内容保持不变；请在 GitHub 设置中单独撤销应用授权。

text: Ask a focused question about this session.
translated: 针对此会话提出一个聚焦的问题。

text: The session operation completed on the previous connection. Check the current session list before continuing.
translated: 会话操作已在上一个连接上完成。请在继续前查看当前会话列表。
忽略 {sender} 对 {channel} 的请求，账户 {account}

text: The replacement process never became healthy. The previous process stayed up so you can recover.
translated: 替换进程从未进入健康状态。之前的进程保持运行，以便你恢复。

text: The session was created, but runner startup failed: {error}
translated: 会话已创建，但运行程序启动失败：{error}

text: Total user and assistant messages in range.
translated: 范围内用户和助手消息总数。

text: OpenClaw kept your local versions and applied the other cloud changes. Inspect the staged result or take its version for a conflicted path.
translated: OpenClaw 保留了你的本地版本并应用了其他云端更改。检查暂存结果，或对冲突路径采用其版本。
已过期 — 需要重新连接
已应用云端结果，存在 {count} 个冲突

text: Best for one-shot reminders that should auto-clean up.
translated: 适用于应自动清理的一次性提醒。

text: The Gateway is likely being accessed through a proxy or tunnel that exposes only its main port. Open this URL from a browser on the Gateway host.
translated: Gateway 很可能通过仅暴露其主端口的代理或隧道进行访问。请在 Gateway 主机上的浏览器中打开此 URL。

text: Your Android phone as a full OpenClaw device — chat, camera, and Canvas.
translated: 将您的 Android 手机作为完整的 OpenClaw 设备——聊天、相机和 Canvas。

text: Start typing to pick a known model, or enter a custom one. Routine jobs (summaries, triage, classification) run well on a lighter model — cheaper and faster than your default.
translated: 开始输入以选择已知模型，或输入自定义模型。常规任务（摘要、分流、分类）在较轻量的模型上运行良好——比默认模型更便宜、更快。

text: From the plugin manifest. OpenClaw validates the plugin against these declarations when it loads.
translated: 来自插件清单。OpenClaw 在加载时会根据这些声明验证插件。

text: Three links worth your coffee, with hot takes.
translated: 三条值得一读的链接，附上简短点评。

text: Side chat is already answering a question.
translated: 侧边聊天正在回答一个问题。

text: No existing AI access was detected. Install one of these tools, then check again.
translated: 未检测到现有的 AI 访问权限。请安装以下工具之一，然后重新检查。
触摸时发出轻微咕噜声

text: This session or Gateway address cannot be continued in a terminal.
translated: 无法在终端中继续此会话或 Gateway 地址。

text: Have voice conversations through this device.
translated: 通过此设备进行语音对话。

text: Update queue metadata and session handoff.
translated: 更新队列元数据和会话交接。

text: The feature setting could not be saved.
Cancel editing and keep the queued message
translated: 取消编辑并保留队列中的消息

text: Restore provider billing or quota, then retry.
translated: 请恢复提供商账单或配额，然后重试。

text: Workspace: {agent}. Save creates a Workshop proposal; apply it after review.
translated: 工作区：{agent}。保存将创建一个 Workshop 提案；请在审阅后应用它。

text: Environment variables passed to the gateway process
translated: 传递给 gateway 进程的环境变量

text: Join the OpenClaw community on Discord
translated: 在 Discord 上加入 OpenClaw 社区

text: The Gateway is restarting. This page disconnects and reconnects on its own. If it stays disconnected, run `openclaw triage` on the Gateway host to open a local coding agent for diagnosis and repair.
translated: Gateway 正在重启。此页面会自动断开并重新连接。如果仍未连接，请在 Gateway 主机上运行 `openclaw triage` 以打开本地编码代理进行诊断和修复。

text: Review Codex consolidated memory and Claude Code auto-memory before copying it into OpenClaw.
translated: 将 Codex 整合记忆和 Claude Code 自动记忆复制到 OpenClaw 前，请先进行检查。
为新运行使用系统身份

text: Use a profile ID that starts with a letter or number and contains only letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
translated: 请使用以字母或数字开头，且仅包含字母、数字、连字符或下划线的配置 ID。

text: Camera access is blocked. Allow camera access in browser site settings.
translated: 摄像头访问被阻止。请在浏览器网站设置中允许访问摄像头和麦克风。

text: Tip: use filters or click bars to refine days.
translated: 提示：使用筛选器或点击条形图来细化日期。

text: Reading the Gateway's retained identity projection…
translated: 正在读取 Gateway 保留的身份投影……
向大家介绍一下你自己...

text: The server is saved globally disabled and enabled only for this session.
translated: 此服务器将保存为全局禁用，仅在此会话中启用。

text: Embedding and retrieval defaults shared by every agent that has no memory override.
translated: 由所有没有记忆覆盖设置的代理共享的嵌入和检索默认值。

text: Set the global default for compact, sandboxed JavaScript tool workflows. On selects Auto for evaluated models; Off disables the default. Per-model Code Mode overrides are in Agent Defaults → Models (Advanced).
translated: 为紧凑、沙盒化的 JavaScript 工具工作流设置全局默认值。开启时会为已评估的模型选择 Auto；关闭则禁用默认值。各模型的 Code Mode 覆盖设置位于 Agent Defaults → Models（Advanced）。

text: Sign in with a Gateway profile to create personal skills. Administrators can still create skills in the selected agent workspace.
translated: 使用 Gateway 配置文件登录以创建个人 skills。管理员仍可在所选 agent 工作区中创建 skills。

text: Finishing connection recovery. Try sending again when it is ready.
translated: 正在完成连接恢复。准备就绪后请重新发送。
此操作需要 operator.admin 访问权限。

text: Glanceable chats and quick replies from your wrist.
translated: 在腕上一目了然地查看聊天并快速回复。
用于接收打赏的 Lightning 地址（LUD-16）

text: Enter a value within the allowed range and step.
translated: 请输入在允许范围和步长内的值。

text: Proposals that can no longer apply cleanly will appear here.
translated: 无法再顺利应用的提案将显示在此处。

text: Profiles and machine sizes for cloud sessions.
translated: 云会话的配置文件和机器规格。

text: Current short-term candidates waiting to graduate into real memory.
translated: 当前等待升级为真实记忆的短期候选项。

text: Removed {name}. A Gateway restart is required to apply the change.
translated: 已移除 {name}。需要重启 Gateway 才能应用更改。

text: Command owners can run privileged commands and approve dangerous actions. This option is only available while no owner is configured.
translated: 命令所有者可以运行特权命令并批准危险操作。此选项仅在未配置所有者时可用。

text: Rewind is unavailable while the agent is working
Creates branch openclaw/<name> in a separate checkout.
translated: 在单独的检出中创建分支 openclaw/<name>。

translated: The plugin that owns this tab is not active on the connected gateway, or it did not provide a panel.

text: {count} sensitive values hidden. Use the reveal button above to edit the raw config.
translated: 已隐藏 {count} 个敏感值。使用上方的显示按钮以编辑原始配置。

text: Stop the foreground Gateway, run `openclaw update`, then launch it again. For automatic updates, install a managed Gateway service.
translated: 停止前台 Gateway，运行 `openclaw update`，然后重新启动它。如需自动更新，请安装受管理的 Gateway 服务。

text: Live plan, quota, balance, and budget data reported by configured providers.
translated: 已配置供应商报告的实时套餐、配额、余额和预算数据。

text: No engine is pinned in config, so the slot falls back to its default owner.
translated: 配置中未固定任何引擎，因此该槽位回退到其默认占用者。

text: Choose a known model provider and save its API key.
translated: 选择已知模型提供商并保存其 API 密钥。

text: Copy {count} selected memory files into this agent workspace.
translated: 将选中的 {count} 个记忆文件复制到此智能体工作区。

text: Show the latest assistant or tool activity beneath running sessions.
translated: 在运行中的会话下方显示最新的助手或工具活动。

text: New requests and alerts land here.
translated: 新的请求和提醒会显示在这里。

text: Disable this automation after the first successful fired task.
translated: 在首次成功触发任务后禁用此自动化。

text: Pairing help (opens in a new tab)
translated: 配对帮助（在新标签页中打开）

text: Stored secrets are never sent to the browser; enter a new value to replace it
translated: 已存储的密钥永远不会发送到浏览器；输入新值以替换它

text: Could not compare this checkout with its tracked upstream
translated: 无法将此检出与其所跟踪的上游进行比较

text: Full content is unavailable because the stored transcript entry is too large to return safely.
translated: 无法获取完整内容，因为存储的转录条目过大，无法安全返回。

text: This Gateway does not offer audit.run.inspect. Upgrade the Gateway, enable execution identity collection, and record a new run.
translated: 此 Gateway 不提供 audit.run.inspect。请升级 Gateway，启用执行身份收集，并记录新的运行。

text: Could not load the pairing dialog. Check your connection and try again.
translated: 无法加载配对对话框。请检查连接后重试。
与你的 Home 智能体对话

text: Filter by key, agent, label, kind…
translated: 按密钥、代理、标签、类型筛选…

text: Click "Edit Profile" to add your name, bio, and avatar.
translated: 点击“编辑个人资料”以添加你的姓名、简介和头像。

text: {channel} just disconnected — ask me what happened
translated: {channel} 刚刚断开连接——问我发生了什么

text: Each profile defines how its provider provisions and retires a worker.
translated: 每个配置文件定义其提供程序如何配置和停用工作程序。

text: A clear board, ready for work
translated: 空白的看板，随时可以开始工作
内存导入需要 operator.admin 访问权限。

text: Tell the agent what should change. The proposal stays pending and the workshop will create a revised version.
translated: 告诉智能体需要更改什么。提案保持待处理状态，工作坊将创建一个修订版本。

text: Session did not connect within 30 seconds.
translated: 未能在 30 秒内连接到会话。

text: My GitHub requires an idle, reconciled local workspace. Wait for work to finish and reclaim the workspace. System and agent publication keep their existing shared flow.
translated: My GitHub 需要一个空闲、已协调的本地工作区。请等待工作完成并回收工作区。系统和智能体发布将保留其现有的共享流程。

text: No automations match the current filters.
translated: 没有任务符合当前筛选条件。

text: The requested desktop source is unavailable. Choose another source.
translated: 请求的桌面源不可用。请选择其他源。

text: This session is archived. Unarchive it to continue the conversation.
translated: 恢复此会话以发送消息。

text: The previous setup attempt may still be running. Wait for its bounded setup window to finish, then choose Check again to retry.
translated: 上一次设置尝试可能仍在运行。请等待其限定的设置窗口完成，然后选择“重新检查”以重试。

text: Runs each session in an isolated Git worktree.
translated: 在隔离的 Git worktree 中运行每个会话。
